from_quote: on the application of the legislatures of two thirds of the States, which at present amount to nine, to call a convention for proposing amendments, which shall be valid, to all intents and purposes, as part of the Constitution, when ratified by the legislatures of three fourths of the States, or by conventions in three fourths thereof.
rationale: The paragraph quotes this article in quotation marks, identifying it as "the fifth article of the plan," and quotes it again as "shall call a convention."
to_quote: on the Application of the Legislatures of two thirds of the several States, shall call a Convention for proposing Amendments
